items.title: Louis Barbarin Interview, 1960-06-22
items.q: And Wilhelmina Barth, you heard of Wilhelmina Barth? Yeah. He was playing piano at the time.

ctx.x: They have a clarinet player with the Imperial Serenaders? A saxophone?

Well, we had a saxophone and clarinet player. We had a trombone with Raymond Brown. You heard of Raymond Brown? Mm-hmm. And I was on the drums, Albert Snoyer was on the trumpet, and George Augustin playing banjo. He's in California now. His dad was the president of the local years back before he passed. And Wilhelmina Barth, you heard of Wilhelmina Barth? Yeah. He was playing piano at the time. Let me see, that's, I can recall. And we had a Jeruzan, a saxophone player. He's in California now. Bass was, bass…
I can't play, Sam. I guess I've heard of him.
